name: One Gas
outlook:
What One Gas says to expect

  • Full year 2026: net income and adjusted earnings per shareBased on strong operational performance, the Company raised its 2026 adjusted earnings expectations, with net income expected to be in the range of $313 million to $317 million, compared with its previously announced range of $310 million to $314 million. Adjusted earnings per diluted share are expected to be approximately $4.95 to $5.01, compared with the previously announced range of $4.89 to $4.95.
  • Full year 2026: capital investmentsCapital investments, including asset removal costs, are still expected to be approximately $800 million in 2026, primarily targeted for system integrity and replacement projects.
The company's own words, from its earnings release (Form 8-K, Exhibit 99), filed November 2, 2026. They are its expectations, not ours, and not a forecast or price target from The Filing Desk. Replaced when the next release is out.
